description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LeaveRequestDetailedModel' that implements data serialization for detailed leave request objects within the Human Resource Management system. It constructs an array representation of leave request details, including employee info, leave dates, balance, breakdowns, actions, comments, and metadata, primarily for API responses.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed leave request data into an array, suitable for API output, including employee info, leave dates, balances, breakdowns, permissible actions, status, comments, and associated types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a DetailedLeaveRequest object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the detailed leave request object into an associative array with structured leave and employee data for serialization.
